reviewer: Separate model agent /root/dense_encoder; not independent human review
review_focus: The original support/interval/semantic manifest is bound through load_manifest(check_artifact_bytes=False); this skips old payloads but does not claim UNSAT.

regenerate_formula checks byte-identical original CNF regeneration. Replacement cores are checked against that original CNF, with no added clauses.
DRAT trimming is untrusted. A fresh DRAT-trim to LRAT to pinned CakeML chain is mandatory for the replacement core.
The final compact manifest requires all original accepted case IDs in their original order, with duplicate rejection and unchanged coverage arithmetic.
Portable replay opens only replacement DRATs, exact original CNFs, and the one inherited LRAT. Old Round7 DRAT payloads are not needed.
Final source and persisted logical byte guards catch changes during replay. Quick replay explicitly does not establish whole-inventory coverage.

The explicit two-worker producer split rejects duplicate case IDs and binds every assigned original row exactly; each worker uses private checker binaries and its own progress/log files. It does not claim whole-inventory completeness.
The portable replay launches at most two processes, gives every case a private temporary directory, and binds case-specific logs to distinct IDs. An exception or a failed case blocks final PASS.

Full replay requires the returned case-ID set to equal the final manifest set and every result to have the mandatory original-CNF CakeML acceptance status. Parallel completion order does not change coverage.
Final global source hashes include the new worker wrapper and the inherited frontier file, closing those previously unpinned replay dependencies.
limitations: No full runtime replay performed by this reviewer; production and portable replay receipts are separate evidence.
